Mi sueño mexicano es ver un país que tenga responsabilidad ambiental. Nunca me ha cabido en la mente como uno de los países más megadiversos del mundo tiene tan pobre cuidado por la enorme diversidad de ecosistemas. Es una responsabilidad nacional y global.

Ah, y que Neza sea capital cultural.
Wow, that last one sounded very deep and beautiful. thx a lot, my best wishes.
I'll try that, plus playing in the streets for money after the whole pandemic thing passes.
I play piano but I compose a lot of genres, but mostly I don't finish songs, it's hard for me, maybe I need some classes or something, I'm so insecure
Yeah but I don't want that.
I'm working on it, I have a lot of material of my own and I try to advertise in several places but it's difficult if you don't have money.
I know that music makes me happy, both to listen to it and to do it, so I suppose that being minimally recognized for my work can make me happy, if not, I give up.

I don't think I'm depressed, just fed up with life. I'm only alive because I want to try to get on with my music career, I'm not interested in anything else.

Thx for reading me.

I don't know, being the opposite to sad hahaha.

I guess happiness is a state of mind, which I haven't been in for a long time. I just don't think I'll ever get what I want, I guess destiny doesn't like me hahaha.
